subject: Next steps: 30-min product intro + stakeholder availability
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightwave.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: 30-min product intro + stakeholder availability

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for a constructive discovery this morning. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: latency-sensitive customer support reranking + embeddings for search.
- Key constraints: EU data residency for PII, target p50 latency ~75ms, and budget guidance for Q4 POC.
- Stakeholders you expect on the demo: Alex (Head of Engineering), Priya (Product), and one of your SREs for the latency questions.

To keep momentum, can we schedule a 30-minute product intro / demo next week that focuses on: live inference flow, quantization options, and typical cost/latency tradeoffs for production workloads? I propose three 30-min windows below (all times in ET):

Option A — Tue Aug 10, 11:00–11:30 AM ET
Option B — Tue Aug 10, 4:00–4:30 PM ET
Option C — Wed Aug 11, 10:30–11:00 AM ET

If none of the above work, send 1–2 windows that do and we’ll accommodate. I’ll invite the right folks from Redwood (Vivek for architecture + Karthik for performance tuning).

Tentative agenda (attached one-pager):
- 5m: goals and scope
- 10m: demo (inference runtime, batching, KV cache)
- 10m: Q&A on latency, quantization, and deployment modes
- 5m: next steps / mutual action plan

Attaching a short agenda + a blank MAP we can fill during the call.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0121

Attachments: redwood-30min-intro-agenda.pdf, brightwave-mutual-action-plan.xlsx

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightwave.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:37:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-min product intro + stakeholder availability

Naomi —

Appreciate the summary. Option B (Tue Aug 10, 4:00–4:30 PM ET) works best for Alex and Priya; our SRE (Jorge) is available but prefers a slightly earlier time if possible. If we need the 4 PM slot, Jorge will still join.

We want to include a brief overview of our current architecture (GKE + Redis) — I can share an ops diagram beforehand if helpful. Also, can you confirm if you will touch on Private/VPC deployment options during the 30-min intro? If not, we can add a 15-min follow-up with our security lead.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director of Product, BrightWave Analytics
liam@brightwave.com | +1 (212) 555-0199

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@brightwave.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-min product intro + stakeholder availability

Liam —

Great — I’ll lock Option B (Tue Aug 10, 4:00–4:30 PM ET). Vivek and Karthik will both join.

Quick answers:
- We will cover Private/VPC options at a high level during the 30-min intro (deployment modes, where data can live, and common compliance patterns). For an in-depth security discussion we recommend a separate 15–30 minute session with our security engineer.
- Please send the ops diagram if you’d like us to call out exact integration points — that will help us prepare the demo to touch on streaming inputs and your Redis caching layer.

I’ll send a calendar invite and include the agenda + MAP in the invite attachments. If Jorge can’t make the 4 PM slot, we can either record the session or do a short follow-up with SRE content.

Confirming attendees we have on our side:
- Naomi Feldman (AE) — meeting lead / commercial next steps
- Vivek Kulkarni (Solutions Architect) — architecture + deployment patterns
- Karthik Iyer (Runtime Perf) — quantization, batching, latency tuning

Thanks — invite follows.

Best,
Naomi

Liam —

Invite sent: Tue, Aug 10 | 4:00–4:30 PM ET (Google Meet link in calendar) — please accept. I attached the agenda and the blank MAP to the invite.

Quick prep notes for your team:
- If you can share a 1-slide ops diagram or a short note on peak request volume (RPS) + average seq length, that will help Karthik tailor the perf portion.

If Jorge needs an earlier time, we can shift to 3:30 PM ET; let me know by EOD Thu Aug 5 and I’ll update.
